findings.problem: Export continued after save failure and could export an older project
Missing media was silently omitted from ZIP; corrupted media was not checked
Unknown job IDs were silently ignored; unchecked project IDs and non-atomic save endangered stored data
Corrupt input replaced the current File and preview even after decoding failed
UI result events returned before edited File state was ready; pending edits could be saved prematurely
Repeated HTTP requests could create duplicate jobs; conflicting reuse was not rejected
Navigation and command chips had no runtime handlers
Unsupported controls appeared usable (settings/account/native window/templates/generation/pan/undo/redo/VIDEO reference)
findings.disposition: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; explicitly disabled with reason, labels/layout/colors retained; not claimed as delivered features

findings.problem: VIDEO unknown commands fell through to SAM tracking
Command/reference input was cleared before runtime outcome; focus could resurrect earlier text
Base editor startup required private HF token; missing model requests did not consistently fail before worker/network work
Korean subtitle renderer hardcoded Windows Malgun font on Linux
Legacy FFmpeg concat list used literal backslash-n and mishandled apostrophes; default imposed 16:9 and omitted browser encoding requirements
Windows separators were not sanitized when storing a filename on another OS
Background removal showed a red SAM overlay rather than transparent foreground
Actual Chrome VIDEO seek failed because media HTTP endpoint lacked byte-range support
Selecting the same source again did not fire file change after the first import
Reference Blob URLs were not revoked on rejected attachment/removal
DOM attributes claimed enabled before-after/batch/keyframe/mask/multitrack editing despite absent runtime controls
findings.disposition: before-after/batch NOT_IMPLEMENTED; timeline explicitly read-only status with actual transport seek; existing labels/layout/colors preserved

findings.problem: Follow-up VIDEO edit retained actual BGM but omitted backgroundVolume from saved options, so Audio Track incorrectly displayed original audio
findings.fix: Store explicit default backgroundVolume when selected BGM is reused
